item.title: What makes a person
item.content:encoded:
You know what'd be interesting?

Finding out if blood samples from this guy attract meteorites. Or cell cultures.

Hair presumably wouldn't, because it's not alive.

Hmm.

Take bone marrow samples. Use a growth-forcing SCP (ooh, or maybe the cloning tree?) to get a few dozen pounds of 488 tissue to work with…

using 488 tissue against SCP-682 would be a bad idea, though, because of the risk of containment breach (and meteorites just aren't interesting enough in that context).
